questions.prompt: What usually strengthens a basic glued butt joint?

questions.why: A butt joint has little surface contact, so glue alone is weak; adding pins or dowels gives mechanical strength the glue can't provide on its own.

questions.subject: Japanese
questions.prompt: What is the Japanese word for the number 3?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: 'San' means three in Japanese; 'shi' is four, 'go' is five, and 'ni' is two — easy to mix up when learning the sequence.

questions.subject: Japanese
questions.prompt: What is the Japanese word for 50?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: 50 is 'gojuu' (五十) — go (5) + juu (10). Yonjuu is 40, sanjuu is 30, rokujuu is 60.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Order these steps of how a shogun kept control of Japan
